confidence_notes: Medellín cost-of-living indexes provide useful typical restaurant, coffee, and beer prices. Cocktail and wine-glass estimates are less certain; the wine-glass estimate uses local bottle pricing and its relationship to beer. Accommodation figures are broad model estimates and were not checked against live listings.
comparable_city_reasoning: Food and drink anchors use Medellín-specific cost-of-living prices; accommodation is estimated for a major Latin American visitor city.
